subject: Renewal + capacity uplift for Atlas Systems — procurement sentinel checklist
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@atlas-sys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Hi Irene,

Quick note from procurement at Atlas — our renewal for the Redwood account hits June 15 and the product team expects a ~2.5x token consumption increase starting July. We need to refresh our vendor onboarding (procurement) packet and confirm PO timing so engineering isn't blocked.

Two asks to start:
- Can you share the current evidence bundle (attestations, SOC2, data retention docs) we should upload to our procurement portal?
- Can Redwood accept a split-PO for June/Sept (initial term + capacity uplift)? Any constraints on terms or billing cadence?

Attaching a short spreadsheet outlining their forecast. I'm cc'ing procurement@atlas-sys.com.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager — Atlas Systems

Attachment: forecast-usage-q3-q4.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Team — forwarding Atlas' ask. They want the evidence bundle and want to explore a split-PO approach to accelerate capacity on July 1. Can you run the "sentinel checklist" flow (procurement readiness + PO acceleration) and confirm what we can commit to in terms, billing cadence, and any gating items on our side?

Key outcomes I need by EOD:
- Marissa: evidence packet that can be uploaded to Atlas procurement portal (single zip).
- Jonas: whether we can accept split-POs and proposed invoice cadence; if not, alternative workflows (e.g., partial invoice + committed capacity credit).
- Tessa: confirm security attestations and any new scoping needed for SOC2 or on-prem connectors.

Add anything else you think we should include in the mutual action plan (MAP). I will coordinate with Legal if terms deviate from standard renewal language.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Renewals, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Irene / team — attaching the evidence packet we currently have pre-bundled for procurement portals. Contents: SOC2 report link, data retention policy, subprocessors list, SLA extract, and standard export controls statement. I've also included a brief annotation doc that matches Atlas' procurement checklist columns so their portal accepts the upload with minimal mapping.

Notes:
- Attachment is a zip (Atlas-evidence-bundle-2028.zip). Please review the README page; I've flagged one item under "custom connectors" that may need legal sign-off if they require on-prem deployment.
- For split-POs: we usually prefer a single PO per fiscal year but can support a two-step PO if finance approves an invoice schedule tied to milestone (initial: term start, second: capacity uplift). I'll loop Finance if Jonas wants to pursue.

Attachment: Atlas-evidence-bundle-2028.zip

Marissa Cole
Renewals Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Quick operational decision: finance is open to a split-PO only if we can ensure the initial invoice covers baseline committed spend and the second invoice is an agreed capacity top-up with a fixed price per token. Alternative is to sign the full-year PO with an amendment for capacity uplift later.

To accelerate: Atlas can upload the bundle to their procurement portal, but our preferred path is DocuSign + single PO with addendum. If Atlas needs week-1 capacity (July 1), we can provision a temporary burst pool for 30 days on a billed pass-through basis while the PO finalizes. That avoids an engineering freeze.

Action items for me:
- Draft PO addendum language and sample invoice cadence.
- Confirm whether our billing system can accept a two-invoice flow tied to token thresholds (should be a yes, will confirm by EOD).

Jonas Weber
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Irene / team — reviewed the SOC2 snapshot in Marissa's bundle. Atlas' procurement portal will want the full 2027 report as a PDF rather than a link. I've exported and attached SOC2-Atlas-2027.pdf.

Security notes:
- No additional controls required for their stated usage today.
- If they push to bring model serving onto a private VPC path or require HSM-managed keys, we will need an additional scoping exercise (2–3 weeks).
- Data retention/export controls documented in the bundle are fine; ensure the DocuSign flow includes the data processing addendum.

Attachment: SOC2-Atlas-2027.pdf

Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@atlas-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, procurement@atlas-sys.com
Date: Sat, 26 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected capacity uplift (June renewal)

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. We're ready to move forward with a MAP and a procurement path that avoids an engineering freeze. Summary below and next steps: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Today: Atlas uploads evidence bundle or we can drop the attached zip into your procurement portal (Marissa).
- 48 hours: Redwood to provide PO addendum language and billing cadence for split-PO option (Jonas).
- 72 hours: Sign DocuSign envelope for baseline term; include Data Processing Addendum (Tessa & Legal).
- July 1: Provision temporary burst capacity (30 days) if PO isn't finalized and Atlas needs immediate scale; billing on actuals until amendment effective.

Attachments included for your upload: Atlas-evidence-bundle-2028.zip, PO-draft-Atlas-Redwood-2028.pdf, SOC2-Atlas-2027.pdf.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/redirect?envelopeId=4b2f-...
HubSpot MAP: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ATL-2028-RNWL-03

Please confirm whether Atlas prefers the single-PO + addendum route or the split-PO plan so Jonas can lock the invoice cadence. If you want, we can arrange a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize the MAP and gating items.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Renewals
Redwood Inference
